herbs.title: Traditional Herbs
herbs.subtitle: Medicinal plants used in Zulu traditional healing (amakhambi)

items.name: African Potato (Hypoxis hemerocallidea)
items.desc: A well-known medicinal plant with a bright yellow star-shaped flower and a tuberous rootstock.
items.infoBoxText: Used for immune support, urinary problems, and general wellness.

items.name: Aloe (Aloe ferox / Aloe marlothii)
items.desc: A robust, single-stemmed succulent with heavily thorned leaves and bright orange-red flowers.
items.infoBoxText: Used to treat wounds, burns, constipation, and skin conditions.

items.name: Buffalo Thorn (Ziziphus mucronata)
items.desc: A deciduous tree known for its distinctive zigzag branches and pairs of thorns—one hooked, one straight.
items.infoBoxText: Deeply spiritual. Used in cleansing rituals, spiritual purification, and to carry the spirit of the deceased. Also treats stomach ailments.

items.name: Cancer Bush (Lessertia frutescens)
items.desc: A much-respected medicinal shrub with silvery leaves and bright red, butterfly-like flowers.
items.infoBoxText: Used for general health support, stress relief, and appetite stimulation.

items.name: Devil's Claw (Harpagophytum procumbens)
items.desc: A creeping plant that produces a peculiar fruit covered in miniature hooks, hence its name.
items.infoBoxText: Widely used to alleviate arthritis, joint pain, and inflammation.

items.name: Elephant Root (Elephantorrhiza elephantina)
items.desc: A small shrub that produces massive, underground rhizomes which contain potent medicinal properties.
items.infoBoxText: Used to treat diarrhea, stomach disorders, and as a wound treatment.

items.name: Fever Tea / Lemon Bush (Lippia javanica)
items.desc: A fragrant, woody shrub whose leaves emit a strong lemon scent when crushed.
items.infoBoxText: Excellent for fever, colds, coughs, respiratory infections, and managing malaria symptoms.

items.name: African Wormwood (Artemisia afra)
items.desc: One of the most widely used traditional medicines in South Africa, possessing a highly aromatic scent.
items.infoBoxText: Boiled as a tea or inhaled as steam for colds, flu, fever, coughs, and digestive complaints.

items.name: Helichrysum (Helichrysum odoratissimum)
items.desc: A strongly aromatic, silvery-grey plant central to indigenous spiritual practices.
items.infoBoxText: Smudged (burned) to communicate with the ancestors. Also used for respiratory complaints and wound care.

items.name: Pepper Bark Tree (Warburgia salutaris)
items.desc: A highly valued medicinal tree whose bark has a strong, peppery taste. Currently heavily protected due to over-harvesting.
items.infoBoxText: Used for coughs, colds, flu, chest infections, and malaria symptoms.

items.name: Thorn Pear (Datura stramonium)
items.desc: A bushy weed with large white trumpet flowers and thorny seed capsules.
items.infoBoxText: Used strictly for traditional external remedies. The plant is highly toxic if ingested.

items.name: Wild Ginger (Siphonochilus aethiopicus)
items.desc: A forest floor plant with beautiful pink flowers, highly sought after for its aromatic rhizomes.
items.infoBoxText: Used for asthma, colds, influenza, and sinus problems.

items.name: Snake Bean Tree (Erythrina lysistemon)
items.desc: Also known as the Coral Tree, notable for its striking bright red tubular flowers.
items.infoBoxText: Medicinally used for wounds and swelling. Also heavily utilized in spiritual and protective uses.
